stateDefinitions.PENDING: 필수 evidence를 아직 시도하지 않았거나 receipt가 없음
stateDefinitions.BLOCKED: artifact·권한·선행 receipt가 없어 재시도 전까지 진행할 수 없음
stateDefinitions.DEFER: 증거가 있더라도 현재 product decision을 의도적으로 보류함

jsonPathSemantics.models: model.models[] is a detector or recognizer entry; exactly one of each role is required for OCR acceptance
jsonPathSemantics.files: model.models[].files[] is sorted by canonical relative path; symlink and traversal paths are rejected
jsonPathSemantics.digests: sha256 values are lowercase 64-hex strings when status is PASS; PENDING is not a digest
jsonPathSemantics.subject: all subjectDigest values must equal execution.observed.executedImageDigest, and each path/sha256/verified evidence field must be non-PENDING/true before acceptance
jsonPathSemantics.platform: image.imageIndexDigest must select image.platformManifestDigest, whose config and base digests match the ledger; canonical(image.os,image.architecture,image.variant) must equal both execution.policy.targetPlatform and execution.observed.targetPlatform
jsonPathSemantics.treeHash: each role hashes UTF-8 canonical lines path\tbytes\tsha256\n sorted by path; verifier output recomputedModelTreeSha256[role] must equal model.models[role].treeSha256
jsonPathSemantics.pairHash:
pairBindingSha256 hashes detector
<detectorTreeSha256>
recognizer
<recognizerTreeSha256>
 in fixed role order, where both tree values are the role entries and verifier outputs
jsonPathSemantics.licenseNotice: each model role requires licenseVerified=true and noticeVerified=true; licenseNotice.complete=true, inventorySha256 and every path must be present and verified
jsonPathSemantics.trustPolicy: producer.repository, producer.workflow, producer.workflowRef, producer.builderIdentity, producer.signerIdentity and producer.oidcIssuer must each be members of their corresponding non-empty allowlists; policySha256 must be verified and verification.trustPolicyMatched is exactly the conjunction of those memberships plus full-commit source policy

verificationRules: repository, workflow path/ref, builder identity and signer identity must be allowlisted

producer.repository ∈ allowedRepositories, producer.workflow ∈ allowedWorkflowPaths, producer.workflowRef ∈ allowedWorkflowRefs, producer.builderIdentity ∈ allowedBuilderIdentities, producer.signerIdentity ∈ allowedSignerIdentities and producer.oidcIssuer ∈ allowedOidcIssuers
sourceRevision must be a full immutable commit
SBOM, provenance and signature subjects must equal executed platform manifest digest
unknown or unauthenticated producer is BLOCKED, not trusted by tag name

failClosedReasons: actual trusted producer artifact is not available in this train
platform-specific image digest and model bytes are not present
SPDX SBOM, provenance, signature, and complete NOTICE are not verified
